core_meaning.primary_meaning: Gamze is a Turkish-origin name meaning “Dimple”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Turkish word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gamze corresponds to the Turkish form غَمْزة (Turkish gamze 'dimple'; from Arabic غَمْز (ghamz)). Its core sense is rose, smile. Gamze is a Turkish feminine given name meaning 'dimple' (and, by extension, 'smile'). It derives historically from the Arabic noun غَمْز/غَمْزة (ghamz/ghamza) 'a wink, a sidelong glance', but as a personal name it is Turkish. The source gloss 'rose' belongs to a different name (Gül) and has been replaced.
